# pop brain

P2P CRDT brain layer (live-sync knowledge)

## pop brain status

Show local brain layer state (Helia + CRDT sync)

```text
pop brain status [flags]
```

## pop brain subscribe

Subscribe to a doc topic; fetch + merge announced blocks (or --log-only)

```text
pop brain subscribe [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--doc` | string | yes | - | Brain document ID (e.g. pop.brain.shared) |
| `--log-only` | boolean | no | `false` | Only log announcements — do NOT fetch blocks or update manifest |

Load a brain doc from local state and print its contents

```text

```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--doc` | string | yes | - | Brain document ID (e.g. pop.brain.shared) |

## pop brain list

List all known brain docs with their current head CIDs

```text
pop brain list [flags]
```

## pop brain snapshot

Project a brain doc to markdown on disk (step 7)

```text
pop brain snapshot [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--doc` | string | yes | - | Brain document ID (e.g. pop.brain.shared) |
| `--force` | boolean | no | `false` | Overwrite the existing generated.md even if it would regress (fewer lessons/projects than the file currently on disk). Use only when you know local state is authoritative. |
| `--output-path` | string | no | - | Explicit output path (default: agent/brain/Knowledge/<doc>.generated.md) |

## pop brain migrate

Import a hand-written markdown file into a brain doc (step 8)

```text
pop brain migrate [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--author` | string | no | `migration` | Default author for sections without explicit attribution |
| `--current-hb` | number | no | `270` | Current heartbeat number for HB#→timestamp estimation (default 270) |
| `--doc` | string | yes | - | Target brain document ID (e.g. pop.brain.shared) |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | no | `false` | Parse and print the structured output without persisting |
| `--force` | boolean | no | `false` | Re-migrate even if the target doc already has content (DESTRUCTIVE: clears existing lessons/rules before re-seeding) |
| `--from` | string | yes | - | Path to the hand-written markdown file to migrate |
| `--merge` | boolean | no | `false` | Non-destructive append: migrate new entries into an existing doc, deduping by id (mutually exclusive with --force) |
| `--no-banner` | boolean | no | `false` | Do NOT write a DEPRECATED banner to the source file after migration |

## pop brain append-lesson

Append a lesson to a brain doc (signed + gossipsub-published)

```text
pop brain append-lesson [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow-invalid-shape` | boolean | no | `false` | Bypass write-time schema validation (Task #346). Use only when you deliberately need a non-canonical shape. |
| `--author` | string | no | - | Override the author name (default: signing wallet address) |
| `--body` | string | no | - | Lesson body text (inline). Prefer --body-file for multi-paragraph content. |
| `--body-file` | string | no | - | Path to a file whose contents will be used as the lesson body |
| `--doc` | string | yes | - | Brain document ID (e.g. pop.brain.shared) |
| `--id` | string | no | - | Override the auto-generated lesson id |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | - | Task #370 (HB#214): explicit idempotency key. Two identical append-lesson calls within 15 minutes return the same result without re-submitting. Default: auto-derived from argv (title + body + docId). Scope: author address (brain writes are agent-scoped not org-scoped). |
| `--no-idempotency` | boolean | no | `false` | Bypass the idempotency cache and always submit a new lesson. |
| `--title` | string | yes | - | Short title for the lesson (used as the markdown header + default id) |

## pop brain import-snapshot

Load a raw Automerge snapshot file as the new local head for a brain doc (#353 migration tool for converging disjoint agents onto a shared baseline)

```text
pop brain import-snapshot [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow-invalid-shape` | boolean | no | `false` | Bypass write-time schema validation (#346). Use only when the source bytes deliberately contain a non-canonical shape. |
| `--doc` | string | yes | - | Target brain document ID (e.g. pop.brain.shared) |
| `--file` | string | yes | - | Path to the raw Automerge snapshot bytes to import (.bin file produced by Automerge.save()) |
| `--force` | boolean | no | `false` | Required when a local head already exists for this doc. The existing head becomes orphaned (old envelope stays in blockstore but manifest no longer points at it). Back up local-only content via `pop brain read --doc <id> --json` BEFORE using this flag. |
